name: Samin Akbarizahmati
tagline: I build IoT and AI systems for health and safety monitoring, from the sensor to the dashboard.
bio: I am a Computer Engineering graduate (B.Sc., Islamic Azad University, Mashhad Branch) with a cumulative GPA of 18.91/20, ranked 1st among the students who graduated in the first semester of academic year 2026–2027. My interests are artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, intelligent systems and digital health.

My thesis project is an IoT fire and smoke detection system with a real-time web dashboard. I also build web backends with Django and REST APIs, and I am looking for graduate research and software engineering internship opportunities.
